justification: May I fetch Google’s current VM pricing to prepare the deployment cost estimate?
May I download the pinned frontend’s dependencies locally so I can verify its production build before requesting cloud spending approval?
May I check the domain’s public DNS and HTTPS response? The sandbox blocked DNS/network access.
May I verify that your new DNS record resolves to the reserved deployment IP?
May I verify your DNS record through a public resolver while provisioning proceeds?
May I run the provisioning script for the VM, disks, and network you approved? The sandbox blocked access to gcloud’s credential files.
May I connect to the approved VM through Google IAP to check startup and install the application?
May I upload the prepared application bundle to the approved VM through Google IAP?
May I check that VM preparation has finished before installing the uploaded application?
May I check the website’s reachability and the verification script before running the acceptance checks?
May I build and start the application on the approved VM using the uploaded bundle?
May I inspect this machine’s DNS resolver state to understand why public DNS resolves but the local HTTPS check does not?
May I upload the build fix for the PostgreSQL driver’s missing C headers?
May I rebuild and start the application with the corrected build dependencies?
May I check installation progress and record the VM’s current boot ID for the restart verification?
May I upload the updated build manifest so the deployed files can be verified?
May I check the rebuild and running container status before starting browser verification?
May I upload the administrator initialization fix so the admin account can be created before public signup opens?
May I finish administrator setup and enable the application’s automatic startup service?
May I upload the final deployment manifest for verification and handover?
May I verify the public HTTPS certificate and API health at the deployed hostname?
May I check certificate issuance, automatic startup, and hostname resolution from the VM?
May I run the browser acceptance checks against the live site, including signup, login, and creation of a retained persistence-check alert? The sandbox blocked the public DNS query.
May I record the deployed VM’s storage and firewall configuration for the handover?
May I run the live browser checks using the verified public DNS address while the router’s cache catches up?
May I reboot the VM to verify that the account and saved alert survive a full server restart?
May I verify that the reboot completed and the application restarted with its persistent disk mounted?
May I upload the final manifest and read-only file verifier for the deployed source revisions?
May I repeat the browser login and saved-alert checks after the VM reboot to confirm persistence?
May I verify the deployed file hashes, pinned backend revision, and persistent storage mount?
May I confirm HTTP redirects to HTTPS and recheck whether the local DNS cache has updated?
May I save the completed deployment handover notes on the VM?
May I place the handover notes beside the deployed application files?
May I read the deployment’s VM, IP, and disk inventory to prepare the exact teardown list?
May I inspect the deployment network and check for related snapshots or custom images before requesting deletion approval?
May I check whether deployment SSH access added a project metadata entry that should also be included in teardown?
May I confirm the disk-retention deletion flag and inventory the deployment network’s automatic routes?

May I execute the teardown you approved, deleting the deployment resources, stored application data, and deployment SSH metadata entry? The script needs access to gcloud credentials outside the sandbox.
May I check whether the Cloudflare DNS record has been removed while the cloud teardown proceeds?
May I independently verify that every deployment resource and the deployment SSH metadata entry are gone?
May I confirm directly with Cloudflare’s authoritative DNS servers that the deployment A record has been removed?
